prompt: ICE HOCKEY PREDICTION MASTER PROMPT v1.0

sources.name: ESPN core league index for hockey
provides: the complete list of hockey leagues ESPN publishes: nhl, mens-college-hockey, womens-college-hockey, hockey-world-cup, olympics-mens-ice-hockey, olympics-womens-ice-hockey

irregularities.title: One price source, not two
irregularities.effect: The prompt requires moneyline, puck line and total cross-referenced across a minimum of two bookmakers. Only one key-less price feed exists (ESPN, republishing DraftKings), so oddsSourceCount is 1 and the cross-reference rule cannot be met. Recorded on every match.

irregularities.title: No confirmed starting goaltender
irregularities.effect: No free feed names a starter for a future game. The engine treats every goaltender as unconfirmed, which vetoes the play in the risk layer, so no HIGH confidence tip can be published until a starter is sourced.

irregularities.title: Special teams and shot metrics unavailable
irregularities.effect: Power play %, penalty kill %, shots for/against per game and blocked shots are not published by the NHL standings feed or the ESPN scoreboard. Those blocks score zero and are recorded as missing.

irregularities.title: No European league feed
irregularities.effect: ESPN publishes only six hockey leagues and none is European; the OLBG slate carries Finnish and Swiss rows with no statistics behind them. European fixtures are listed and scored as data-poor, which resolves to SKIP.

irregularities.title: No retained closing lines
irregularities.effect: Prices are stripped once a game is final, so puck line and total markets cannot be backtested and ROI cannot be computed. Forward collection is the only route to a priced ledger.

irregularities.title: OLBG row count differs from the index render
irregularities.effect: data/olbg_sports.json counted four ice hockey events on 2026-09-02 while the index rendered three event cards above its Load More Tips control. The committed slate holds the three rows that were actually read.

irregularities.title: Collectors could not be executed in this workspace
irregularities.effect: The sandbox has no outbound network, so scripts/collect_ice_hockey_nhl.mjs and the live OLBG fetch were not run here. Every endpoint above was verified individually during review and the fixtures committed were transcribed from those verified responses. The scheduled CI workflow runs the collectors for real.
